oneLine: Investcorp explores exit from Kitchen Treasures at up to Rs 1,000 crore valuation.

sources.title: Investcorp eyes exit from Kitchen Treasures at up to ₹1,000 crore valuation

synopsis: Bahrain-based investment firm Investcorp is exploring an exit from its investment in Intergrow Brands, the parent entity of Kerala-based Kitchen Treasures, through a secondary sale of its sub-25% stake. The deal is expected to value the food and spice brand at Rs 800-1,000 crore, with the formal launch anticipated early next year as Investcorp engages with advisors. The transaction may also include a primary component if the company seeks external capital for acquisitions. Investcorp originally invested about Rs 80 crore in 2019. Kitchen Treasures is owned by the Synthite Group through Intergrow Brands.
